description: This script automates testing of a Git protocol transition, including cloning and fetching repositories over different protocol versions with different transfer methods, and involves starting/stopping a Git daemon.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a Git daemon with all exports enabled for testing purposes.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the previously started Git daemon.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting it to succeed.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
